title_en: Call for Participants: 3rd SNU AZIT × SNAAC The Beginning Ideathon 2026
summary: Seoul National University students who are enrolled or on leave of absence, undergraduate or graduate, may apply to the 3rd SNU AZIT × SNAAC The Beginning Ideathon. Applications must be submitted through the online application link by Thursday, 26 November 2026. The ideathon is an overnight event held from 28 to 29 December 2026 at Mondrian Seoul Itaewon.
applies_to: Seoul National University students who are currently enrolled or on leave of absence, whether undergraduate or graduate. Participation is by application; the notice does not state that it is mandatory.

dates.what: Ideathon event (overnight, two days and one night)

conditions: Only students currently enrolled at or on leave of absence from Seoul National University are eligible.
Both undergraduate and graduate students may apply.
Participation is entirely free of charge, and accommodation and meals are provided.
steps: Optionally review the attached poster ("제3회 AZIT Ⅹ SNAAC 더 비기닝 아이디어톤 포스터.png"); its content was not read for this translation.
Apply through the online application link (https://startup.snu.ac.kr/bbs/board.php?bo_table=sub4_2&wr_id=24) by Thursday, 26 November 2026.
If selected, attend the ideathon on 28–29 December 2026 at Mondrian Seoul Itaewon (23 Jangmun-ro, Yongsan-gu, Seoul).
translation:
Call for Participants: 2026 3rd SNU AZIT × SNAAC The Beginning Ideathon

1. Program: 2026 3rd SNU AZIT X SNAAC The Beginning Ideathon

2. Date: Monday, 28 December – Tuesday, 29 December 2026 (two days, one night)

3. Venue: Mondrian Seoul Itaewon (23 Jangmun-ro, Yongsan-gu, Seoul)

4. Eligibility: Seoul National University students who are enrolled or on leave of absence (undergraduate or graduate)

5. Benefits: Participation fee fully waived; accommodation and meals provided

6. Application period: Until Thursday, 26 November 2026

7. Application link: https://startup.snu.ac.kr/bbs/board.php?bo_table=sub4_2&wr_id=24

Attachment (1 file): 제3회 AZIT Ⅹ SNAAC 더 비기닝 아이디어톤 포스터.png (poster, 1 MB). The content of this image was not read for this translation.
